method: AUDIT IN -> FINDINGS -> REMEDIATION -> VERIFICATION -> AUDIT OUT

layers.name: Frontend foundations
evidence: The clean release suite and browser tests pass; protected Preview dpl_CPqjxie64YwfUrrar3qzGrdr3WoF rendered the truthful first-use concierge at 602x623 without horizontal overflow and kept workspace controls hidden until real state exists.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:web-release && npm run test:browser:vault
layers.failureDetails: Full hosted accessibility/performance evidence and Production behavior remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Capture retained hosted accessibility/performance evidence, then repeat bounded route, console, and responsive checks after production approval.

layers.name: APIs and backend logic
evidence: API security, resilience, idempotency, output-boundary, and serverless import tests pass locally across 41 routes; Preview liveness and live-discovery smoke passed with durable limiting and submissions disabled.
layers.failureDetails: Signed-user Preview flows and production API behavior remain unknown; Preview readiness correctly fails closed on incomplete infrastructure.
layers.remediation: Configure an isolated signed-beta environment, run safe signed-user Preview probes, and perform bounded Production acceptance only after release approval.

layers.name: Database and storage
evidence: Static inventory verifies one CLI-generated canonical migration reconciled from three reviewed sources, 20 source tables with RLS and forced RLS, explicit anon/authenticated revokes, operation-specific backend policies, no destructive statements, and zero non-tenant-scoped child-to-parent references; the pgTAP pack is implemented but was not run.
layers.failureDetails: No isolated target was proven. Applied history, drift, runtime grants, tenant denial, advisor results, backup/PITR policy, private object storage, restore integrity, RPO, and RTO remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Prove a disposable local or isolated staging target, apply the reconciled canonical migration there, pass adversarial pgTAP and advisors, verify private object storage, then complete a separately authorized restore drill.

layers.name: Authentication and permissions
evidence: Opaque signed-session, revocation, tenant ownership, admin-role, entitlement, and consent tests pass locally.
layers.testCommand: node scripts/user-session-test.mjs && node scripts/api-security-test.mjs && node scripts/clerk-identity-test.mjs
layers.failureDetails: Current production identity-provider configuration and signed-user flows were not inspected or exercised in this task.
layers.remediation: Verify a least-privilege staging account matrix, session revocation, admin denial, and tenant-crossing denial using the exact release commit.

layers.name: Hosting and deployment
evidence: Clean commit d899db2 passed the complete release gate and protected Preview dpl_CPqjxie64YwfUrrar3qzGrdr3WoF is Ready with 56 static assets, 41 functions, no internal-source leaks, and working nested health routes.
layers.testCommand: npm run release:gate && npm run test:deployment-output
layers.failureDetails: Production still serves an older artifact and has not been changed; remote CI for the candidate is also unknown.
layers.remediation: Push the reviewed candidate, require a green remote CI run, then obtain explicit production approval before promotion and bounded acceptance checks.

layers.name: Cloud and compute
evidence: Function durations, fail-closed feature flags, spend limits, bounded concurrency, and isolated-worker contracts exist and have local tests.
layers.failureDetails: Runtime quotas, regional behavior, cold starts, saturation, and vendor failure behavior are unknown for the release candidate.
layers.remediation: Record Vercel plan limits, regions, concurrency assumptions, and a bounded staging fault/load exercise without enabling employer actions.

layers.name: CI/CD and version control
evidence: A pinned-action Node 24 workflow now runs the full deterministic release gate; clean-source preflight and source inventory tests exist.
layers.failureDetails: The new workflow has not yet executed in GitHub and the working tree remains heavily dirty.
layers.remediation: Create an isolated commit, open a review, require the Production Readiness Gate branch check, and verify the remote CI result before release review.

layers.name: Security and row-level security
evidence: Static checks verify RLS intent, forced RLS, explicit anon/authenticated/PUBLIC revocation, operation-specific policies explicitly scoped to job_agent_backend, composite tenant constraints, no user_metadata authorization reference, and no service-role marker in the browser bundle; zero cross-tenant reference risks remain in source.
layers.failureDetails: Applied runtime grants, Data API exposure, policy evaluation for anon/authenticated/backend roles, adversarial cross-tenant denial, advisors, and live service-role boundaries remain unverified.
layers.remediation: Apply only to a proven isolated target, pass the role-aware adversarial pgTAP suite and advisors, inspect the exposed schema/grant matrix, and retain redacted evidence tied to the canonical migration digest.

layers.name: Rate limiting
evidence: Durable tenant/global rate limits, hashed partitions, fail-closed configuration, and local regression tests exist; a prior operator round trip proved Upstash reachability but current parity was not rechecked.
layers.failureDetails: Current deployed limits, alert thresholds, and behavior under concurrent tenants are not verified.
layers.remediation: Run an approved staging concurrency test and a bounded production readiness probe that records only aggregate decisions and latency.

layers.name: Caching and CDN
evidence: Preview verified concierge and API Cache-Control no-store, strict concierge CSP/security headers, and homepage public max-age=300 with stale-while-revalidate=60.
layers.failureDetails: Production headers, invalidation behavior, error-route caching, and authenticated cross-user cache isolation remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Repeat header checks after production approval and add signed-user cache-isolation and error-route scenarios.

layers.name: Load balancing and scaling
evidence: Discovery work is concurrency bounded and provider circuit breakers isolate failing sources; serverless execution supplies managed horizontal routing.
layers.failureDetails: No measured capacity, queue-depth SLO, regional failover evidence, or tenant-fairness load result exists.
layers.remediation: Define beta load assumptions and run a capped synthetic staging test covering queue depth, rate-limit fairness, source failure, and recovery.

layers.name: Error tracking and logs
evidence: Content-free structured events, admin-only health/dependency routes, worker heartbeat state, audit-chain tests, and operator-alert queues exist; a bounded Preview runtime-log read corroborated expected synthetic 200/401/503 outcomes without application log payloads.
layers.failureDetails: No production log-drain retention, alert delivery receipt, dashboard SLO, or on-call acknowledgement was verified.
layers.remediation: Configure an approved redacted log/alert destination, perform a synthetic non-user incident delivery test, and record ownership, retention, and acknowledgement evidence.

layers.name: Availability and recovery
evidence: Lease recovery, retries, circuit breaking, health endpoints, encrypted-record recovery code, and content-free database recovery evidence requirements exist; local synthetic application tests pass.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/encrypted-record-recovery-test.mjs && npm run test:database-evidence
layers.failureDetails: Provider backup cadence/retention/PITR, isolated restore behavior, database integrity reconciliation, measured RPO/RTO, and alert delivery have not been verified.
layers.remediation: After separate operator and cost approval, verify backup/PITR configuration, restore into an isolated target, reconcile content-free counts and links, measure RPO/RTO, and retain signed redacted evidence.
